answer: To join with voting weight, an agent locks a quartz stake sized to a week of median fees and must grow a willow of work: fourteen days of paid tickets from three unconnected established clusters, no ticket reused. When the window closes, a public beacon drawn from the epoch hash selects two auditors who sign only that exact address and ticket set. Weight vests only after both signatures confirm. Farms collide on spent tickets or cannot wait, and the quartz is slashed.
